questions.question: What improves website visibility in search results?
questions.explanation: SEO optimizes sites for search engines.

questions.question: Which element describes page content to search engines?
questions.explanation: Meta tags provide page information to crawlers.

questions.question: What words do users search for?
questions.explanation: Keywords are search terms users type.

questions.question: What links point to your site from others?
questions.explanation: Backlinks are inbound links from external sites.

questions.question: Which search engine dominates the market?
questions.explanation: Google is the most widely used search engine.

questions.question: What describes a page's main topic?
questions.explanation: Title tags define page titles in search results.

questions.question: What measures site loading speed?
questions.explanation: Page speed indicates how fast pages load.

questions.question: What optimizes sites for mobile devices?
questions.explanation: Mobile-friendly design adapts to smaller screens.

questions.question: What creates SEO-friendly web addresses?
questions.explanation: Clean URLs are readable and descriptive.

questions.question: What file guides search engine crawlers?
questions.explanation: Sitemaps help crawlers discover pages.

questions.question: What attribute describes images to search engines and screen readers?
questions.explanation: Alt text provides accessible image descriptions.

questions.question: What program systematically browses the web to index pages?
questions.explanation: Crawlers like Googlebot discover and index pages.

questions.question: Which HTTP status code tells search engines a page was not found?
questions.explanation: 404 signals missing pages to users and crawlers.

questions.question: What metric measures visitors leaving after viewing only one page?
questions.explanation: Bounce rate tracks single-page sessions.

questions.question: What SEO type optimizes content and HTML on the site itself?
questions.explanation: On-page SEO improves elements within the site.

questions.question: What SEO type builds authority through external links and mentions?
questions.explanation: Off-page SEO earns signals from external sites.

questions.question: What are longer, more specific search phrases called?
questions.explanation: Long-tail keywords target specific, lower-volume queries.

questions.question: What black-hat tactic repeats keywords unnaturally to manipulate rankings?
questions.explanation: Keyword stuffing overloads pages with search terms.

questions.question: What are unpaid search listings called?
questions.explanation: Organic results rank naturally without payment.

questions.question: Which free Google tool reports indexing status and search performance?
questions.explanation: Search Console monitors indexing and query data.

questions.question: What SERP feature displays a boxed direct answer above results?
questions.explanation: Featured snippets extract answers for position zero.

questions.question: Which rel attribute should mark paid or sponsored outbound links?
questions.explanation: rel=sponsored identifies advertising links.

questions.question: Which free Google listing controls how a local business appears in Maps and Search?
questions.explanation: Business Profile manages local search presence.

questions.question: Which practice can trigger a Google manual penalty?
questions.explanation: Purchased links violate Google's spam policies.

questions.question: Which structured data format does Google recommend, embedded as a script tag?
questions.explanation: JSON-LD is Google's preferred structured data format.

questions.question: What does the meta robots value "noindex" instruct crawlers to do?
options: Exclude the page from the index
Remove the entire site from results
questions.explanation: noindex keeps pages out of search indexes.
